name: Numeric with tolerance — figures that move between fetches
purpose: Resolve a number where honest pages quote slightly different figures; the request's tolerance band decides agreement.
expected_outcome: RESOLVED when the leading figures sit within tolerance_bps of each other; UNRESOLVED_CONFLICT when they exceed it.

create_flow_inputs.step_1_question: What is the current total market capitalization of Bitcoin in USD?
create_flow_inputs.step_8_review_expect: tolerance of 5.00% rendered in the review; validity of one hour

manual_checks_after_observe: Each numeric claim appears verbatim inside its grounded quote — no unit conversion.
Claims outside the freshness requirement are marked excluded, never conflicting.
The reconciled state is the median figure of the winning cluster.
After one hour the detail page flags the result as past validity; record expiry live.
notes: Some trackers block bots; an UNAVAILABLE row is not a contradiction — that behavior is part of what you are verifying.
